title: Banyan Tree Beach Residences Varuna
shortDescription: Eight beachfront townhomes on Bang Tao Beach inside Laguna Phuket, launched by Banyan Group Residences in July 2026.
description: Eight beachfront townhomes on Bang Tao Beach inside Laguna Phuket, launched by Banyan Group Residences in July 2026. Each four-level home pairs a private lift and garden terrace with a west-facing rooftop infinity pool, and the master suite occupies its own floor. Owners get membership perks across Laguna and Banyan Group.
facilities: Private rooftop infinity pool and terrace
Floor-to-ceiling glazing with Andaman Sea views
